name: Phoenix Art Museum
notes: Phoenix Art Museum on Central Avenue: the north wing (Alden B. Dow's 1959 museum and later galleries), the spine and the south wing of Tod Williams Billie Tsien's expansions (1996, 2006) in sandblasted grey concrete, flat roofs with the raised top-lit galleries and the tall exhibition hall, the glazed entrance hall on the avenue, the sculpture garden between the wings, palms along Central. Footprints and storey counts from the OpenStreetMap ground; description from general knowledge. No photographs were available: which parts are Dow's and which TWBT's, the roof lights and heights are approximate. Refined 30 Sep 2026 (no photographs reachable; the ground file's OpenStreetMap outlines): the whole model was mirrored east for west — Central Avenue runs along the museum's west side, not its east — and the museum's point moved 76 m west to the middle of the complex (PARTNER_SPOTS in build_museums.py; its ground re-cut), so the model now stands on its outlines; an east range of galleries added (28 m by 56 m, about three storeys, with a raised top-lit roof), closing the ring round the sculpture garden as the outlines show. Still guessed: which ranges are Dow's and which Williams and Tsien's, the heights and roof lights.
